pages.text: Draconic Evolution is what unlocks the $(l)Tier 8 Fabricator$(), the largest machine in the mod at 9×9.$(br2)Its four base corners must be $(l)Awakened Draconium$() blocks. Without Draconic Evolution installed there is no such block, so Tier 8 simply does not form and Tier 7 is the ceiling.

The Tier 8 spool and the Tier 8 Fabricator both take awakened draconium to craft.$(br2)Six draconic materials carry pinned values across $(l)Tier 7$() and $(l)Tier 8$(). Base draconium sits at Tier 7; awakened draconium is the only Tier 8 material in the game.
